Vance Koehler

Onboarding Specialist

Vance meets with potential clients to evaluate their legal needs and ensure a good fit with our firm. His extensive experience with finance and entrepreneurship, particularly in the auto industry, allows him to quickly understand complex financial situations as well as the unique challenges faced by our clients, including concerns about overwhelming debt, tax issues, auto loans and the ramifications of criminal charges on driving privileges and finances.
